lines.trans: Chairwoman, does this now prove what I told you earlier?
Xingtian's chief editor team truly is the most capable team in the industry.
Chairwoman, Sister Xingzi, Brother Kaiwen, and I are certainly capable.
However, I think there is a deeper reason why this crisis was handled so successfully.
What it proves is not our ability, rather the value of the workflow Mr Chun Yuqiao left behind.
Chairwoman, can you now put a proposal before the board of directors?
Can we recall our chief producer back to the company?
Both the official crisis and our personal mission are completely settled!
Just look how briefly the boss has been away!
Heaven never lets down those who pour their hearts into trying.
